thread:
Maya Luo: Quick sync — tiny iteration on the Playground streaming UX. Clip: https://img.redwood.dev/plays/stream-mini.mp4. Two things: placement/priority for Stop vs Regenerate during streaming, and how the token estimate behaves when a prompt from the library is appended mid-stream. Also dark mode contrast on the token badge looks low.

Ryan Chen: Vote for Stop as the dominant action while streaming. Make Stop the left-most, give it a filled destructive style, Regenerate stays secondary. Add Esc as Stop hotkey.

Jules Park: Accessibility: announce start/stop via aria-live polite messages (e.g., "Assistant started streaming" / "Assistant stopped"). Token badge should expose a clear SR label: "Token estimate: 38, updating" -> "Tokens: 38" when final.

Samira K.: Found a repro: append a prompt from library -> auto-run -> click Stop mid-stream, token badge often shows the earlier estimate and never updates. Fix options: show a live estimate while streaming then flip to final on end, or dim the badge while streaming and announce "estimate updating". I prefer live estimate + a transient flip animation to final.

Kevin O.: Keyboard flow: Tab order currently hits the prompt drawer before Stop/Regenerate. Reorder so Stop -> Regenerate -> Prompt drawer. When a prompt is appended and triggers a run, focus should go to the composer input. Touch targets: Stop must be >=44px.

Maya Luo: Copy tweak: change prompt action from "Insert" to "Append to composer". When append happens during a run, show a small non-modal toast: "Prompt queued — will run after current generation" with action "Run now (cancel current)". Default = queue.

Jules Park: Toast should be aria-live and keyboard reachable; Enter activates "Run now", Esc dismisses. Also ensure the toast doesn't steal focus unexpectedly.

ui-test-bot: A11y smoke: token badge contrast fails in dark theme. Report: https://ci.redwood.dev/a11y/10102/report.

Maya Luo: Plan: I'll open a small PR with (1) button order + Esc hotkey, (2) token badge SR copy + live region, (3) color tweaks (token text -> #d9eefc on #17202a). Will also add the queued-toast UI. Will ping design for review.

Ryan Chen: Implementation note: Stop should be idempotent (no-op if already stopped).

Samira K.: I'll validate the badge flip animation and color changes in dark mode.

Kevin O.: I'll add a couple keyboard e2e tests for tab order and toast actions.

Maya Luo: Thanks all — PR incoming. :thumbsup:
